title: Howie Roseman on Andy Dalton trade: I sleep better knowing we have three QBs who can play

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Howie Roseman on Andy Dalton trade: I sleep better knowing we have three QBs who can play
sources.description: The Eagles' trade for quarterback Andy Dalton was not a reflection on Tanner McKee, the 2023 sixth-round pick who backed up Jalen Hurts last season.
